business_summary: Queclink Wireless Solutions Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides IoT solution worldwide. It offers transportation products for use in fleet management, stolen vehicle recovery, insurance telematics, OBD, motorcycle, and video telematics, as well as accessories; Queclink Connect, a factory-integrated global IoT connectivity; @Track Protocol Pro, a protocol for data transmission; QPAK, a service tool designed for simplifying the integration of Queclink devices; and QMS, an update and management system. The company's products are also used in asset and mobility industry, such as asset security, asset tracking, personal security, and scooter; networks industry comprising routers and OBD; and livestock industry, which includes herd management and food traceability. It exports its products. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
